**Coca-Cola's operating income rose about 26% from fiscal Q1 2024 to fiscal Q4 2024.** These figures are rebuilt from recalled margins and revenues rather than taken from the filings, so they may be off by a few million dollars.

| Quarter | Revenue | Operating margin | Operating income |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 2024 | ~$11.3B | 18.9% | ~$2,141M |
| Q4 2024 | ~$11.5B | 23.5% | ~$2,705M |

- **Q1 2024:** I recall operating income of about $2,141 million; the margin was depressed by a fairlife contingent-consideration charge. Revenue times margin gives about $2,136 million, which is consistent.
- **Q4 2024:** I took full-year 2024 operating income of about $9,992 million and subtracted Q1–Q3. That gives about $2,705 million.
  - Q2 was about $2,633 million (21.3% margin on $12,363 million revenue).
  - Q3 was about $2,513 million (21.2% margin on $11,854 million revenue).
  - As a check, the reported Q4 margin of 23.5% on revenue of about $11.5 billion gives roughly $2,713 million, which agrees.

**Change:** $2,705M ÷ $2,141M − 1 ≈ 26.3%.
